name: STAR Frames — equatorial-galactic directions
summary: Galactic longitude and latitude from equatorial directions and back, in the Hipparcos (ICRS) and IAU 1958 (B1950) definitions; agrees with ERFA, astropy and SPICE to 1.1e-13 deg on 600 directions in both directions and refuses out-of-range input.
reference: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, Example 13.b: B1950 (267.248917, -14.718944) has galactic l = 12.9593, b = +6.0463
reference_observed: (12.959251, 6.046298): within 4.9e-5 deg of the printed values (printed to 1e-4)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: degrees in and out; the system (icrs or b1950) is an explicit argument; output ranges stated
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; longitude at a pole documented as undefined; no iteration
